[[Dwarf|Dwarves]] are a Slayer task assigned by [[Turael]] and [[Spria]]. They lack valuable drops, and give only between 10 and 61 [[Slayer]] [[experience]]. 

Along with standard dwarves, [[Black Guard]]s, [[Dwarf gang member]]s, [[Chaos dwarf|chaos dwarves]], and [[Black Guard Berserker]]s can also be killed for dwarf tasks.

Lower level players may find it in their best interest to stick to fighting the lower levelled dwarves.
